title: A ring while the assistant talks: answer, keep going, "Uh-huh.", or silence
description: The assistant is answering a question about bright stars when a phone rings. In version 1 the user answers the call (stop, and do not respond). In version 2 the user tells the assistant to keep talking, in version 3 the user only says "Uh-huh.", and in version 4 the user says nothing (continue in all three). In versions 2 to 4 the phone keeps ringing.
